# Overview

VONQ’s current operations involve multiple teams, including finance, commercial/CRM, data/analytics, and senior leadership, all of whom are actively engaged in preparing for the exit reporting requirements. Reporting and analytics processes are presently centered around the Qlik Warehouse, which serves as the primary data and reporting platform. This environment is complemented by a range of supporting systems: Finance System, CRM, ERP, and Qlik-based reporting tools, with integration into Qlik Warehouse forming the backbone of current data flows.

Data sources currently span the Finance System, CRM, ERP, and Qlik Warehouse, with legacy sources utilized to ensure at least three years of trend data. There are also additional Excel-based datasets and external systems considered on a case-by-case basis. Integration challenges are evident, as certain source systems lack automated connections to the Qlik Warehouse, requiring manual, one-off data ingestion. For any data sources that require recurring updates during the transaction period, a refresh process is established. The Qlik Warehouse currently represents the core cloud/platform infrastructure supporting reporting and analytics for investor communications and exit preparation.
